name: my-crm
description: Provider-neutral CRM operations across tenant-scoped BOS-connected customer data sources.
long_description: My CRM gives authorized users one CRM operating vocabulary across connected customer and lead systems. It discovers source capabilities through BOS, runs source-aware record, pipeline, and activity workflows, preserves provenance and freshness, builds merged views, and applies governed cross-source synchronization through durable per-source plans and recovery.
default_prompts: Show me the latest leads across my connected CRM sources.
Explain how you would find and merge this customer across my CRM sources.
Compare this customer across sources and show conflicts without changing anything.
